name: FUN_OUTBOUND_CONSUMERS_
description: This table defines the properties of an outbound consumer type.

columns.name: CONSUMER_ID
columns.description: Identifies the ERP outbound consumer.

columns.name: CONSUMER_CODE
columns.description: Code used to identify the outbound consumer.

columns.name: CONSUMER_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Code to identify outbound consumer group. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_FUN_CTLG_CONSUMER_GRPS.

columns.name: CONSUMER_NAME
columns.description: Identifies name of the outbound consumer.

columns.name: DATA_FORMAT
columns.description: Data format used for the extract.

columns.name: EXTRACT_ENGINE
columns.description: Engine name used for the extract.

columns.name: EXTRACT_MODE
columns.description: Extraction mode used. Possible values are Full and Incremental.

columns.name: TARGET_STORE
columns.description: Target store of the extract data.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the consumer is active.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Indicates the unique identifier of the application.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
